name: Form I: Shii-Cho
description: The Determination Form, or The Way of the Sarlacc. The oldest and most basic form, focusing on fundamental swordplay techniques. It is effective against multiple opponents but lacks refinement for single combat.

levels.effect: You gain a +1 bonus to your Parry score when using a lightsaber. You may target one additional opponent in a single attack action at a -4 penalty to skill for each additional target.
You gain a +2 bonus to your Parry score. You may target one additional opponent at a -3 penalty. You gain a +1 bonus to your attack roll against any opponent who parries your attack.

You gain a +3 bonus to your Parry score. You may target two additional opponents at a -3 penalty each. You gain a +2 bonus to your attack roll against any opponent who parries your attack, and you may make a rapid Feint and attack against one opponent at a -1 skill penalty to the attack.

You gain a +4 bonus to your Parry score. You may target two additional opponents at a -2 penalty each. You gain a +3 bonus to your attack roll against any opponent who parries your attack, and you may make a rapid Feint and attack against one opponent with no penalty to the attack. You are adept at breaking defenses, gaining +1 damage against shields or active defenses.

name: Form II: Makashi
description: The Contention Form, or The Way of the Ysalamir. A highly refined and elegant form, specializing in lightsaber dueling. Makashi emphasizes precision, economy of motion, and focused parries and ripostes against a single opponent.

levels.effect: You gain a +1 bonus to Feint skill rolls and a +1 bonus to your Parry score when facing a single opponent wielding a melee weapon. Your thrusting attacks with a lightsaber inflict +1 damage.

You gain a +2 bonus to Feint skill rolls and a +2 bonus to your Parry score against a single opponent. Your thrusting attacks with a lightsaber inflict +2 damage. On a successful Parry, your next attack against that opponent this turn gains a +1 skill bonus.

You gain a +3 bonus to Feint skill rolls and a +3 bonus to your Parry score against a single opponent. Your thrusting attacks with a lightsaber inflict +3 damage. On a successful Parry, your next attack gains a +2 skill bonus. You may attempt a Disarming Strike at one less penalty than normal.

You gain a +4 bonus to Feint skill rolls and a +4 bonus to your Parry score against a single opponent. Your thrusting attacks with a lightsaber inflict +4 damage. On a successful Parry, your next attack gains a +3 skill bonus. You may attempt a Disarming Strike at no penalty. If your opponent attempts to All-Out Attack, you gain a +1 bonus to your counter-attack.

name: Form III: Soresu
description: The Resilience Form, or The Way of the Mynock. The ultimate defensive lightsaber form, emphasizing tight, efficient movements to create an impenetrable defense. Ideal for blaster deflection and protecting oneself from overwhelming attacks.

levels.effect: You gain a +1 bonus to all Active Defenses (Parry, Dodge, Block) when using a lightsaber.

You gain a +2 bonus to all Active Defenses. When parrying a blaster bolt, on a successful Lightsaber Combat skill roll, you may choose to redirect the bolt at a new target within 5 yards (requires a separate attack roll at -4 skill).
You gain a +3 bonus to all Active Defenses. Redirected blaster bolts are at -2 skill. You also gain DR 1 (Limited: Energy, Front) while maintaining a defensive posture.

You gain a +4 bonus to all Active Defenses. Redirected blaster bolts are at no penalty. You gain DR 2 (Limited: Energy, Front), and critical hits against you with energy attacks are reduced by one level.

name: Form IV: Ataru
description: The Aggression Form, or The Way of the Hawk-Bat. A highly acrobatic and aggressive form, relying on Force-enhanced agility, speed, and powerful leaps to overwhelm opponents with swift, unpredictable attacks.

levels.effect: Gain +2 to Basic Move and +1 to Jumping. You may make one extra attack at -3 skill penalty if you also move at least 2 yards.
Gain +4 to Basic Move and +2 to Jumping. You may make one extra attack at -2 skill penalty after moving. Gain +1 Dodge if you moved 3+ yards.
Gain +6 to Basic Move and +3 to Jumping. You may make one extra attack at -1 skill penalty after moving. Gain +2 Dodge if you moved 3+ yards. Can perform a 'Force-assisted Pounce'.
Gain +8 to Basic Move and +4 to Jumping. You may make two extra attacks at -2 skill penalty after moving. Gain +3 Dodge if you moved 3+ yards. Ignore 1 point of penalty from range/cover after a leap.

name: Form V: Shien / Djem So
description: The Perseverance Form, or The Way of the Krayt Dragon. A physically demanding form focused on raw power and strong counter-attacks, particularly effective at deflecting blaster bolts back at their originators and overwhelming opponents with heavy strikes.

levels.effect: Your melee attacks with a lightsaber inflict +1 damage. When parrying a blaster bolt, you may make an immediate counter-attack with the deflected bolt at a -5 skill penalty.
Your melee attacks inflict +2 damage. Counter-attack with deflected bolt at -3 penalty. If you successfully parry a melee attack, your next counter-attack gains a +1 skill bonus.

Your melee attacks inflict +3 damage. Counter-attack with deflected bolt at -1 penalty. If you successfully parry a melee attack, your next counter-attack gains a +2 skill bonus. Gain +1 to Feint rolls.

Your melee attacks inflict +4 damage. Counter-attack with deflected bolt at no penalty. If you successfully parry a melee attack, your next counter-attack gains a +3 skill bonus. Gain +2 to Feint rolls, and can ignore 1 point of DR on a hit by 3+.

name: Form VI: Niman
description: The Moderation Form, or The Way of the Rancor. A balanced and versatile form, focusing on integrating basic lightsaber combat with Force powers.

levels.effect: Suffer one less penalty (min -1) when attempting a Force power while attacking/defending. Gain +1 to Will rolls when using Force powers in combat.
Suffer one less penalty (min 0) when attempting a Force power while attacking/defending. Gain +2 to Will rolls. Can maintain two Force powers at once.
No penalty for using Force powers and lightsaber combat simultaneously. Gain +3 to Will rolls. Can maintain two related Force powers for the FP cost of one.

No penalty for Force/saber use, and gain a +1 bonus to Lightsaber Combat if you successfully cast a Force power. Gain +4 to Will rolls. Can use two different Force powers in the same turn at -1 penalty each.

name: Form VII: Juyo / Vaapad
baseSkill: Lightsaber Combat (DX/Hard), Will (to resist Dark Side influence)
description: The Ferocity Form, or The Way of the Vornskr. A highly aggressive and unpredictable form that channels the user's emotions. Exceptionally potent but carries a high risk of drawing the user closer to the Dark Side.
specialNote: Consistent use may require Fright Checks for Dark Side temptation or cause accumulation of Dark Side Points (GM's discretion).

levels.effect: Gain +1 to attack rolls, but suffer -1 to all Active Defenses. Can make one additional Feint per turn at a -2 penalty.
Gain +2 to attack rolls, but suffer -2 to Active Defenses. Can make one additional Feint at no penalty. Cause +1 injury on a critical hit.
Gain +3 to attack rolls, but suffer -3 to Active Defenses. Can make one additional Feint at +1. Cause +2 injury on a critical hit. Gain +1 to Intimidation rolls vs single opponent.

Gain +4 to attack rolls, but suffer -4 to Active Defenses. Can make two additional Feints at no penalty. Cause +3 injury on a critical hit. Gain +2 to Intimidation rolls. On a critical success, may force a Fright Check on your opponent.
